response: No. According to the Business Travel Policy, any international trip (or any trip over $2,000) must be approved by a manager **at Director level or above**, and that requirement applies regardless of the traveler’s own seniority — a Senior Manager does not meet the “Director‑level or above” threshold. The seniority tiers confirm that “Senior Manager” is below Director level (travel.md & procurement.md). Therefore a Senior Manager cannot approve his or her own $2,500 international trip; a Director‑level approver is required.
